about_the_game:
No-one truly knows who they are until they find themselves backed into a corner.

Explore your new "prison", build fun tools to entertain yourself, or serious ones to break out. But beware... If you dig yourself an even deeper hole, you just might be in big trouble.

Key Features

  • Realtime RPG-style combat with rescuable party members

  • Crafting upgrades for new weapons, thermal vision, stealth armour, mind-control, and more

  • Customisation with your choice of accessories, weapons and armour.

  • Original story featuring no famous people whatsoever.

Spoiler Version

Well, well, well. Look who finally decided to show up. 

There's not a second to lose. Class V members were last seen attending a remote exhibition when the central power grid suddenly and permanently went offline.
